name: Starloft - Light Painting
summary:
Paint with glowing light in mid-air, under a night sky.

Starloft is a single-player light-painting app. Draw a campfire, a galaxy or your name in light. Hold a trigger and a bright line of light stays in the air. Short hints show what to press next while you keep painting.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 12 brushes, including Light, Fire, Stars and Snow
• Color, brush size, undo, redo and eraser
• Mirror mode for symmetrical shapes
• Grab your painting with both hands: move it, turn it and scale it up until it surrounds
